arxiv-1905-08974.title: Cartesian Tree Matching and Indexing
arxiv-1905-08974.creator: Sung Gwan Park, Amihood Amir, Gad M. Landau, Kunsoo Park
arxiv-1905-08974.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Sung Gwan Park, Amihood Amir, Gad M. Landau, Kunsoo Park. We introduce a new metric of match, called Cartesian tree matching , which means that two strings match if they have the same Cartesian trees. Based on Cartesian tree matching, we define single pattern matching for a text of length n n and a pattern of length m m , and multiple pattern matching for a text of length n n and k k patterns of total length m m .

arxiv-2309-13164.title: Optimal data compression for Lyman- α \alpha forest cosmology 2023 Optimal data compression for Lyman- α \alpha forest cosmology – A
arxiv-2309-13164.creator: Francesca Gerardi, Andrei Cuceu, Benjamin Joachimi, Seshadri Nadathur, Andreu Font-Ribera
arxiv-2309-13164.description: Abstract The Lyman- α \alpha (Ly α \alpha ) three-dimensional correlation functions have been widely used to perform cosmological inference using the baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) scale. While the traditional inference approach employs a data vector with several thousand data points, we apply near-maximal score compression down to tens of compressed data elements.

arxiv-2404-08034.title: A non-Perturbative and Background-Independent Formulation of Quadratic Gravity
arxiv-2404-08034.creator: Alberto Salvio
arxiv-2404-08034.description: Abstract ——————————————————————————————————————————— Abstract A non-perturbative and background-independent quantum formulation of quadratic gravity is provided. A canonical quantization procedure introduced in previous works, named after Dirac and Pauli, is here applied to quadratic gravity to obtain, as required by consistency, a well-defined Euclidean path integral. The theory is unitary: all probabilities are non negative and they sum up to one.

arxiv-2412-05762.title: The UV Sensitivity of Axion Monodromy Inflation
arxiv-2412-05762.creator: Enrico Pajer, Dong-Gang Wang, Bowei Zhang
arxiv-2412-05762.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Enrico Pajer, Dong-Gang Wang, Bowei Zhang. We revisit axion monodromy inflation in the context of UV-inspired models and point out that its cosmological observables are sensitive to heavy fields with masses far above the Hubble scale, such as the moduli of flux compactifications. By studying a string-inspired two-field extension of axion monodromy with a small turning rate, we reveal that the oscillatory modulation of the axion potential leads to continuous excitation of heavy fields during inflation when the modulation frequency exceeds the field masses.

arxiv-2507-05956.title: Frobenius and Verschiebung for K K -theory of endomorphisms
arxiv-2507-05956.creator: Sanjana Agarwal, Jonathan Campbell, Diego Manco, Kate Ponto, Zhonghui Sun
arxiv-2507-05956.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sanjana Agarwal, Jonathan Campbell, Diego Manco, Kate Ponto, Zhonghui Sun. We show that the Frobenius and Verschiebung maps that are fundamental to Witt vectors lift to the reduced K K -theory of endomorphisms. In particular, we define Frobenius and Verschiebung maps for the reduced K K -theory of twisted endomorphisms of modules over non commutative rings and show they have the expected behavior after applying the iterated trace map.
